title: Account
summary: Mara's Account page at Profile: the display h1, the canonical section list (Profile, Sign-in methods, Connected apps, Packages, Where you're signed in, Appearance, Your data) as a jump list on the side and a strip on narrow screens, the Profile identity row, her sign-in methods and the one package token that serves every product's feeds.
compare: One section list everywhere, in this order (B12, portal-28): Profile · Sign-in methods · Connected apps · Packages · Where you're signed in · Appearance · Your data. 'Access tokens' is gone; package tokens live only in Packages.
The h1 is the display step (48/52, 32/36 on a phone), no full stop, no eyebrow, no slogan (B12).
Package tokens are account-wide (F-33): revoking says it stops installs on every machine using it; product pages only point here.
Risky actions sit in their own sections (Your data); Sign out is outlined in the header; no filled primary on the page.
Phone: the section strip scrolls with its fade only while it overflows; the bottom bar stays.

Round 2 (UX review): Every canonical section is drawn in order (Profile, Sign-in methods, Connected apps, Packages, Where you're signed in, Appearance, Your data); row actions sit in their own column and drop under the text on a phone; the 40px picture has its own column (M8).
